label: pass
title: slugify produces repeated and leading/trailing dashes, and drops accented letters
body:
`slugify` in src/format.js has a few problems:

- `slugify('  C++ -- The   Good Parts!  ')` returns `c----the-good-parts` — repeated dashes should collapse to one: `c-the-good-parts`.
- `slugify('-Hello-')` should not start or end with a dash: `hello`.
- Accented letters are removed instead of transliterated: `slugify('Café Society')` gives `caf-society`, expected `cafe-society`.

Please fix it and add tests for these cases.
plan:
Fix slugify in src/format.js to properly transliterate accented characters, collapse repeated separators into single dashes, and trim leading/trailing dashes. Add unit tests covering the reported C++/dash collapsing, leading/trailing dash trimming, and accented-letter transliteration.
1. Update slugify to normalize/transliterate diacritics, replace non-alphanumerics with dashes, collapse repeats, and trim dashes
2. Extend format tests with the three new slugify cases
requirements: slugify('  C++ -- The   Good Parts!  ') must return 'c-the-good-parts' with repeated dashes collapsed to one
slugify('-Hello-') must not start or end with a dash; result must be 'hello'
slugify('Café Society') must transliterate accented letters; result must be 'cafe-society'
Add automated tests for the above three cases in test/format.test.js
summary:
Updated src/format.js slugify to NFKD-normalize and remove combining marks (transliteration of accents), replace any run of non-alphanumeric chars with a single dash, and trim leading/trailing dashes. Extended test/format.test.js with three new cases: collapsing C++ separators, trimming dashes around Hello, and transliterating Café to cafe.

Requirements:
1. src/format.js slugify now transliterates with normalize('NFKD') + removing combining marks, replaces non-alphanumerics with '-', collapses via +, and trims leading/trailing dashes (meets R1–R3)
2. test/format.test.js adds the three automated slugify cases (meets R4)
patch:
diff --git a/src/format.js b/src/format.js
index d5cc1f9..8cdcc86 100644
--- a/src/format.js
+++ b/src/format.js
@@ -22,11 +22,17 @@ export function formatCurrency(cents, currency = 'USD') {
  * @param {string} text
  */
 export function slugify(text) {
+  // 1) Normalize to split accented characters (e.g., é -> e + ́)
+  // 2) Strip combining marks to transliterate Latin accents
+  // 3) Replace any run of non-alphanumerics with a single dash
+  // 4) Trim leading/trailing dashes
   return String(text)
     .toLowerCase()
     .trim()
-    .replace(/[^a-z0-9\s-]/g, '')
-    .replace(/\s+/g, '-')
+    .normalize('NFKD')
+    .replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, '')
+    .replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '-')
+    .replace(/^-+|-+$/g, '')
 }
 
 /**
diff --git a/test/format.test.js b/test/format.test.js
index 66c8de7..d4de942 100644
--- a/test/format.test.js
+++ b/test/format.test.js
@@ -13,6 +13,15 @@ test('slugify basic titles', () => {
   assert.equal(slugify('Clean Code'), 'clean-code')
 })
 
+test('slugify collapses separators and trims dashes', () => {
+  assert.equal(slugify('  C++ -- The   Good Parts!  '), 'c-the-good-parts')
+  assert.equal(slugify('-Hello-'), 'hello')
+})
+
+test('slugify transliterates accented letters', () => {
+  assert.equal(slugify('Café Society'), 'cafe-society')
+})
+
 test('formatDate', () => {
   assert.equal(formatDate('2017-03-16T10:00:00Z'), '2017-03-16')
   assert.throws(() => formatDate('nope'), TypeError)
